name: Kamata
source:
Pikari Cleaning personnel.
During the day Kamata attends a nail art school. In the future he would like to save some money and open his own nail salon.

Don't like what you see? Kamata is the owner of a delicate heart.
He seems to have a crush on his coworker [url=/c4980]Vlad[/url]...

His type of (wo)man: Tough guys who get what they want using their power ヾ(≧∇≦*)〃
Special Skills: Leave cooking to me! o(^o^)o

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
